claims.text: Harding was the son of Holfast Gardner and a great-grandson of Samwise Gamgee, the hero of the War of the Ring. He became known as "of the Hill".
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "The Longfather-tree of Master Samwise"
